source_refs.note: Roman Urdu: practice short questions written from Chapter 3 (PDF 54-74), not printed in the book; same questions and order as the English set. Drafts needing academic review.

blocks.text: Yeh chapter 3 (Circular and Rotational Motion) ke poore chapter se practice short questions (mukhtasar sawal) hain, chapter ke sections ki tarteeb mein, Board ke 2 number wale sawal ke andaz mein. Har sawal ka mukhtasar model jawab hai; chhote numericals mein hal ke qadam hain, aur farq wale sawal ka jawab table mein hai.

blocks.prompt:
1 Define one radian.
(Aik radian ki definition likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Agar daire ke arc (qaus) AB ki lambai radius r ke barabar ho to markaz O par banne wala angle aik radian kehlata hai. Yeh angle ki SI unit hai; symbol rad.

book_ref.quote: then the angle is called one radian

blocks.prompt:
2 A body moves in a circle with constant speed. Why is its velocity not constant?
(Jism circle mein yaksaan speed se chalta hai. Us ki velocity constant kyun nahi?)
blocks.explanation: Gol raaste par harkat ki simt musalsal badalti hai. Velocity vector hai, is liye sirf simt badalne se bhi velocity badal jati hai, chahe speed constant ho.

book_ref.quote: this change of direction means that their velocities are not constant

blocks.prompt:
3 What is angular displacement? When is it treated as a vector?
(Angular displacement kya hai? Ise vector kab mana jata hai?)
blocks.explanation: Waqfe Δt mein line OP jitna angle Δθ ghoomti hai woh angular displacement (zaviyai haqeeqi faasla) hai. Counter clockwise ke liye positive. Sirf bohat chhote Δθ ke liye yeh vector hai, aur us ki simt axis of rotation ke saath hai.

book_ref.quote: defines the angular displacement of OP during the time interval

blocks.prompt:
4 State the right hand rule for the direction of angular displacement.
(Angular displacement ki simt ke liye right hand rule bayan karein.)
blocks.explanation: Axis of rotation ko daayen haath mein pakrein aur ungliyan ghoomne ke rukh mein mudein; angootha angular displacement ki simt (axis ke saath) batata hai.

book_ref.quote: Grasp the axis of rotation in right hand with fingers curling in the direction of rotation

blocks.prompt:
5 Name the units of angular displacement and give the relations between them.
(Angular displacement ki units ke naam aur un ke darmiyan ta'alluq likhein.)
blocks.explanation:
Degree, revolution aur radian.
1 revolution = 2π rad = 360°
1 rad = 360°/2π = 57.3°

book_ref.quote: Three units are generally used to express angular displacement

blocks.prompt:
6 Express an angle of 450° in radians and in revolutions.
(450° ke angle ko radian aur revolutions mein likhein.)
blocks.explanation:
Radian mein: 450° × (2π/360°) = 2.5π rad = 7.85 rad
Revolutions mein: 450/360 = 1.25 rev

book_ref.quote: Consider an arc of length S of a circle of radius r

blocks.prompt:
7 Define angular velocity. Give its SI unit and direction.
(Angular velocity ki definition, SI unit aur simt likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Angular velocity angular displacement ke waqt ke saath badalne ki sharah hai: ω_av = Δθ/Δt; Δt → 0 par instantaneous ω. SI unit: rad s⁻¹ (rpm bhi). Simt: right hand rule se axis of rotation ke saath.

book_ref.quote: defined as the rate at which the angular displacement is changing with time

blocks.prompt:
8 A grinding wheel rotates at 900 rpm. Find its angular velocity in rad s⁻¹.
(Aik grinding wheel 900 rpm par ghoomta hai. Us ki angular velocity rad s⁻¹ mein nikalein.)
blocks.explanation:
900 rev/min = 15 rev s⁻¹
ω = 15 × 2π = 30π = 94.2 rad s⁻¹

book_ref.quote: Sometimes it is also given in terms of revolution per minute (rpm).

blocks.prompt:
9 Define angular acceleration. Give its unit and direction.
(Angular acceleration ki definition, unit aur simt likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Angular acceleration angular velocity ki tabdeeli ki sharah hai: α_av = Δω/Δt; Δt → 0 par instantaneous α. Unit: rad s⁻². Yeh vector hai aur axis of rotation ke saath hai.

book_ref.quote: We define angular acceleration as the rate of change of angular velocity.

blocks.prompt:
10 What is the reference line of a rotating rigid body? Why is it useful?
(Ghoomte rigid body ki reference line kya hai? Yeh kyun mufeed hai?)
blocks.explanation: Jism ke point P se axis par giraya gaya amood OP reference line hai. Yeh jism wali angular velocity aur angular acceleration se ghoomti hai, is liye poore rigid body ki rotation OP ki rotation se bayan ho jati hai.

book_ref.quote: usually referred as the reference line

blocks.prompt:
11 Why is the linear velocity of a point on a rotating body called tangential velocity?
(Ghoomte jism ke point ki linear velocity ko tangential velocity kyun kehte hain?)
blocks.explanation: Δt → 0 par arc P₁P₂ bohat chhota ho kar P₁ par tangent ke rukh ho jata hai. Is liye P ki velocity hamesha us point par tangent ke saath hoti hai, isi liye ise tangential velocity kehte hain.

book_ref.quote: the linear velocity of the point P is also known as tangential velocity

blocks.prompt:
12 Differentiate between linear (tangential) velocity and angular velocity.
(Linear (tangential) velocity aur angular velocity mein farq bayan karein.)
blocks.explanation: Linear velocity batati hai point circle par kitni tezi se chalta hai; angular velocity batati hai reference line kitni tezi se ghoomti hai.

book_ref.quote: We are interested in finding out the relation between ω and v.

rows: Circle par faasle ki tabdeeli ki sharah (ΔS/Δt).
Angular displacement ki tabdeeli ki sharah (Δθ/Δt).
Axis se mukhtalif faasle wale points ke liye mukhtalif.
Rigid body ke sab points ke liye aik jaisi.

blocks.prompt:
13 A wheel of radius 0.35 m rotates at 12 rad s⁻¹. Find the linear speed of a point on its rim.
(0.35 m radius ka pahiya 12 rad s⁻¹ se ghoomta hai. Kinare ke point ki linear speed nikalein.)

book_ref.quote: Imagine a point P in the rigid body at a perpendicular distance r from the axis of rotation.

blocks.prompt:
14 On a rotating rigid body, which quantities are the same for all points and which are not? Why?
(Ghoomte rigid body par kaun si quantities sab points ke liye aik jaisi hain aur kaun si nahi? Kyun?)
blocks.explanation: Angular displacement, angular speed aur angular acceleration sab points ke liye aik jaise hain. Linear speed v = rω aur tangential acceleration aₜ = rα r par munhasir hain, is liye axis se mukhtalif faasle wale points ke liye mukhtalif.

book_ref.quote: points that are at different distances from the axis do not have the same speed or acceleration

blocks.prompt:
15 Write the equations of angular motion with their linear counterparts.
(Angular motion ki equations un ke linear jor ke saath likhein.)
blocks.explanation: S, v aur a ki jagah θ, ω aur α rakhein:

book_ref.quote: Given below are angular equations together with their linear counterparts.

blocks.prompt:
16 Under what condition do the equations of angular motion hold? Why?
(Angular motion ki equations kis shart par sahi hain? Kyun?)
blocks.explanation: Yeh sirf tab sahi hain jab axis of rotation fixed ho. Tab sab angular vectors (θ, ω, α) ki simt axis ke saath aik hoti hai, is liye unhein scalars ki tarah istemal kar sakte hain.

book_ref.quote: hold true only in the case when the axis of rotation is fixed, so that all the angular vectors have the same direction

blocks.prompt:
17 A wheel starts from rest with a uniform angular acceleration of 4.0 rad s⁻². Find its angular velocity and the angle turned after 5.0 s.
(Pahiya saakin halat se 4.0 rad s⁻² ki yaksaan angular acceleration se chalta hai. 5.0 s baad angular velocity aur ghooma hua angle nikalein.)

book_ref.quote: Assuming deceleration to be uniform, find its value.

blocks.prompt:
18 Define centripetal force and write its formula.
(Centripetal force ki definition aur formula likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Particle ke seedhe raaste ko gol raaste mein morne wali force centripetal (markaz-joo) force hai. Yeh radius ke saath markaz ki taraf lagti hai: F꜀ = mv²/r = mrω².

book_ref.quote: The force needed to bend the straight path of the particle into a circular path is called the centripetal force.

blocks.prompt:
19 Why does the centripetal force not change the speed of a body moving in a circle?
(Centripetal force gol raaste par chalte jism ki speed kyun nahi badalti?)
blocks.explanation: Centripetal force radius ke saath, har point par tangential velocity par amoodi lagti hai. Velocity par amoodi force sirf simt badalti hai, is liye speed wohi rehti hai.

book_ref.quote: The force that does not alter speed but only direction at each point is a perpendicular force

blocks.prompt:
20 A ball whirled on a string moves off along a tangent when the string snaps. Why?
(Dhaage se ghoomti gend dhaaga tootne par tangent ke saath kyun nikal jati hai?)
blocks.explanation: Dhaage ka tension hi centripetal force thi jo raasta gol rakhti thi. A par dhaaga tootne se centripetal force khatam, is liye gend A wali velocity, yani tangent AB ke saath, chalti rehti hai.

book_ref.quote: the ball will follow the straight line path AB which is tangent AB at point A

blocks.prompt:
21 Differentiate between the effect of a force acting along the velocity of a moving body and a force acting perpendicular to it.
(Harkat karte jism ki velocity ke rukh mein lagne wali force aur us par amoodi force ke asar mein farq bayan karein.)
blocks.explanation: Velocity ke rukh mein force speed badalti hai; amoodi force sirf simt badalti hai.

book_ref.quote: A force acting on a moving body along the direction of its velocity will change magnitude of the velocity (speed) keeping the direction unchanged.

rows: Harkat ki simt wohi rehti hai.
Jism seedhi line mein chalta hai.
Jism circle mein chalta hai (centripetal force).

blocks.prompt:
22 Show that the centripetal force can be written as F꜀ = mrω².
(Sabit karein ke centripetal force F꜀ = mrω² likhi ja sakti hai.)
blocks.explanation:
F꜀ = mv²/r. v = rω rakhne se:
F꜀ = m(rω)²/r = mrω²

book_ref.quote: As v = rω, so the above equation becomes:

blocks.prompt:
23 A 1.5 kg ball moves at 3.0 m s⁻¹ in a horizontal circle of radius 2.0 m. Find the centripetal force on it.
(1.5 kg ki gend 2.0 m radius ke ufuqi circle mein 3.0 m s⁻¹ se chalti hai. Us par centripetal force nikalein.)

book_ref.quote: For a body of mass m moving with velocity v in a circular path of radius r

blocks.prompt:
24 A record of diameter 30 cm turns at 45 rpm. Find the radial acceleration of a point on its rim.
(30 cm diameter ka record 45 rpm par ghoomta hai. Kinare ke point ki radial acceleration nikalein.)

book_ref.quote: what is the radial acceleration of a point on the outer rim of the CD

blocks.prompt:
25 Write the tension in the string at the top of a vertical circle. When does it become zero?
(Vertical circle ke sab se oopar dhaage ka tension likhein. Yeh kab sifr hota hai?)
blocks.explanation: Oopar tension T aur wazan mg dono markaz ki taraf hain: T + mg = mv²/r, is liye T = m(v²/r − g). Jab v²/r = g ho to T = 0; tab sirf wazan centripetal force deta hai.

book_ref.quote: two forces act on the ball, the pull of the string and the weight w of the ball

blocks.prompt:
26 Why does water not fall out of a bucket whirled rapidly in a vertical circle, even at the top?
(Vertical circle mein tezi se ghumayi gayi baalti se paani oopar bhi kyun nahi girta?)
blocks.explanation: Oopar paani ko markaz ki taraf mv²/r centripetal force chahiye. Tez raftaar par mv²/r wazan mg se zyada (ya barabar) hota hai, is liye wazan aur baalti ka dhakka mil kar sirf paani ko circle par rakhne mein kharch hota hai; paani baahar nahi girta.

book_ref.quote: When a bucket full of water is rapidly whirled in a vertical circular path

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text: Example 3.3 ki tarah: oopar T + mg = mv²/r. Baalti mein T ki jagah baalti ke tale ka dhakka hai. Jab tak v²/r ≥ g hai, wazan akela kaafi nahi balkay kam parta hai, is liye paani tale se laga rehta hai.

blocks.prompt:
27 What provides the centripetal force (i) for an object placed on a rotating turntable (ii) for a charged particle in a perpendicular magnetic field?
(Centripetal force kaun deta hai (i) ghoomte turntable par rakhi cheez ko (ii) amoodi magnetic field mein charged particle ko?)
blocks.explanation:
(i) Cheez aur turntable ke darmiyan friction.
(ii) Amoodi magnetic force, jo charged particle ke seedhe raaste ko circle mein mor deti hai.

book_ref.quote: In every circular or orbital motion, centripetal force is needed which is provided by some agency.

blocks.prompt:
28 Why are highway roads banked at turns?
(Highway sarkon ko moron par banked (dhalwaan) kyun banaya jata hai?)
blocks.explanation: Hamwaar sarak par mor ke liye centripetal force tyres aur sarak ki friction deti hai. Phisalwaan sarak aur tez raftaar par friction kaafi nahi hoti, gaari phisal ya ulat sakti hai. Is liye bahar wala kinara thora ooncha rakha jata hai, kyunke sirf friction zaroori centripetal force nahi de sakti.

book_ref.quote: To overcome this difficulty, the highway road is banked on turns.

blocks.prompt:
29 A 1200 kg car takes a turn of radius 80 m at 20 m s⁻¹ on a level road. How much friction must the road provide?
(1200 kg ki car hamwaar sarak par 80 m radius ka mor 20 m s⁻¹ se leti hai. Sarak ko kitni friction deni hogi?)
blocks.explanation:
Friction hi centripetal force hai:
F = mv²/r = 1200 × 400/80 = 6000 N

book_ref.quote: which is provided by the friction between the tyres and the road

blocks.prompt:
30 What is a centrifuge? State its principle.
(Centrifuge kya hai? Is ka usool bayan karein.)
blocks.explanation: Centrifuge laboratory ka aala hai jo mixture ko tezi se ghuma kar bhaari aur halke zarraat alag karta hai. Usool: agar force zaroori centripetal force se kam ho to zarra markaz se door jata hai; bhaari zarraat tube ke neeche aur halke oopar aa jaate hain.

book_ref.quote: The centrifuge (Fig. 3.8-a) functions on this basic principle.

blocks.prompt:
31 How does the dryer of a washing machine dry the clothes?
(Washing machine ka dryer kapre kaise sukhata hai?)
blocks.explanation: Geele kapre suraakhon wale lambe cylinder mein rakh kar use tezi se ghumaya jata hai. Paani par force use circle mein rakhne ke liye kaafi nahi, is liye paani bahar deewaron ki taraf ja kar suraakhon se nikal jata hai.

book_ref.quote: The dryer consists of a long cylinder with hundreds of small holes on its wall.

blocks.prompt:
32 What are artificial satellites? What keeps them in their orbits?
(Masnooi satellites kya hain? Unhein orbit mein kya rakhta hai?)
blocks.explanation: Satellites woh cheezen hain jo Zameen ke gird taqreeban gol raaste par ghoomti hain. Rockets unhein orbit mein dalte hain aur Zameen ki gravity unhein wahan rakhti hai, jo centripetal acceleration v²/r deti hai.

book_ref.quote: Satellites are objects that orbit in nearly circular path around the Earth.

blocks.prompt:
33 What is critical velocity? Write its expression.
(Critical velocity kya hai? Is ka formula likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Critical velocity woh kam az kam velocity hai jo satellite ko (Zameen ke qareeb) orbit mein dalne ke liye zaroori hai. g = v²/R se v = √(gR); g = 9.8 m s⁻² aur R = 6.4 × 10⁶ m par v = 7.9 km s⁻¹.

book_ref.quote: This is the minimum velocity necessary to put a satellite into the orbit, called the critical velocity.

blocks.prompt:
34 A satellite moves in a circular orbit of radius 6.67 × 10⁶ m where the gravitational acceleration is 9.0 m s⁻². Find its orbital speed.
(Satellite 6.67 × 10⁶ m radius ke gol orbit mein hai jahan gravitational acceleration 9.0 m s⁻² hai. Us ki orbital speed nikalein.)
blocks.explanation:
Gravity centripetal acceleration deti hai: g = v²/r
v = √(9.0 × 6.67 × 10⁶) = 7.75 km s⁻¹

book_ref.quote: In a circular orbit around the Earth, the centripetal acceleration is supplied by gravity and we have

blocks.prompt:
35 Compare a satellite orbiting close to the Earth with one orbiting at a height much greater than the Earth's radius.
(Zameen ke qareeb ghoomne wale satellite ka muqabla Zameen ke radius se kahin zyada oonchai wale satellite se karein.)
blocks.explanation: Faasle ke saath gravity kam hoti hai, is liye ooncha satellite ahista chalta hai aur zyada waqt leta hai.

book_ref.quote: The higher the satellite, the slower will be the required speed and longer it will take to complete one revolution around the Earth.

rows: Markaz ki taraf acceleration taqreeban 9.8 m s⁻².
Acceleration kam (markaz se faasle ke murabba ke ulat).
Critical velocity taqreeban 7.9 km s⁻¹ chahiye.

blocks.prompt:
36 Show that the orbital speed of a satellite does not depend on its mass.
(Sabit karein ke satellite ki orbital speed us ke mass par munhasir nahi.)
blocks.explanation:
Gravitational force = zaroori centripetal force:
GmₛM/r² = mₛv²/r
mₛ kat jata hai: v = √(GM/r). Is liye r par har satellite ki speed aik hai, mass jo bhi ho.

book_ref.quote: This shows that the mass of the satellite is unimportant in describing the satellite's orbit.

blocks.prompt:
37 Find the orbital speed of a satellite at a height of 3600 km above the Earth's surface. (G = 6.67 × 10⁻¹¹ N m² kg⁻², M = 6.0 × 10²⁴ kg, R = 6400 km)
(Zameen ki satah se 3600 km oonchai par satellite ki orbital speed nikalein. (G = 6.67 × 10⁻¹¹ N m² kg⁻², M = 6.0 × 10²⁴ kg, R = 6400 km))

book_ref.quote: Equating the gravitational force to the required centripetal force, we have

blocks.prompt:
38 What happens if a satellite at distance r from the Earth's centre has a speed less than √(GM/r)?
(Agar Zameen ke markaz se r faasle par satellite ki speed √(GM/r) se kam ho to kya hoga?)
blocks.explanation: r faasle par satellite ki speed v = √(GM/r) honi chahiye. Is se kam speed use gol orbit mein nahi rakh sakti; woh wapas Zameen par gir aata hai.

book_ref.quote: Any speed less than this will bring the satellite tumbling back to the Earth.

blocks.prompt:
39 Show that a spring balance inside an orbiting satellite reads zero.
(Sabit karein ke ghoomte satellite mein spring balance sifr reading deta hai.)
blocks.explanation: Balance par mass m ke liye: mv²/r = mg − F_N (Eq. 3.16-a). Satellite ke liye Mg = Mv²/r, yani g = v²/r. Is se mg = mg − F_N, yani F_N = 0; balance sifr dikhata hai.

book_ref.quote: This shows that the supporting force which is acting on a body inside the satellite is zero.

blocks.prompt:
40 Why is the weightlessness in a satellite called apparent?
(Satellite mein be-wazni ko zahiri (apparent) kyun kehte hain?)
blocks.explanation: Zameen ki gravity ab bhi jismon par lagti hai aur orbit ki centripetal force deti hai; sirf sahara dene wali (normal) force sifr hoti hai. Satellite aur us ki har cheez saath saath azad girti hai, is liye be-wazni sirf zahiri hai.

book_ref.quote: the bodies as well as the astronauts in a satellite find themselves in a state of apparent weightlessness

blocks.prompt:
41 Why is artificial gravity needed in a spacecraft, and how is it produced?
(Spacecraft mein artificial gravity kyun chahiye aur kaise paida hoti hai?)
blocks.explanation: Lambe arse tak be-wazni astronauts ki karkardagi mutassir kar sakti hai. Spaceship ko apne axis par ghumaya jata hai; farsh (bahar ka kinara) astronaut ko dhakel kar centripetal force deta hai, aur woh Zameen ki tarah farsh par dabta hai.

book_ref.quote: the weightlessness may affect the performance of the astronauts present in that spacecraft

blocks.prompt:
42 A spaceship of radius 200 m must provide Earth-like gravity (g = 9.8 m s⁻²). Find its frequency of rotation and period.
(200 m radius ke spaceship ko Zameen jaisi gravity (g = 9.8 m s⁻²) deni hai. Ghoomne ki frequency aur period nikalein.)
blocks.explanation:
f = (1/2π)√(9.8/200) = 0.0352 Hz
T = 1/f = 28.4 s (taqreeban 2.1 chakkar per minute)

book_ref.quote: When the spaceship rotates with this frequency, the artificial gravity like the Earth is provided to the inhabitants of the spaceship.

blocks.prompt:
43 A space station of radius 30 m completes one rotation in 15 s. Find the centripetal acceleration at its outer rim.
(30 m radius ka space station 15 s mein aik chakkar poora karta hai. Bahar ke kinare par centripetal acceleration nikalein.)
blocks.explanation:
a꜀ = 4π²R/t² = 30 × 39.5/225 = 5.3 m s⁻²
(Yeh centripetal acceleration hai; yaksaan ω par angular acceleration sifr hai.)

book_ref.quote: is the centripetal acceleration of a point on the outer rim, not an angular acceleration

blocks.prompt:
44 Define moment of inertia. Write its expression for a rigid body.
(Moment of inertia ki definition likhein. Rigid body ke liye is ka formula likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Axis se r faasle par m mass ke particle ke liye mr² us ka moment of inertia I hai. Rigid body ke liye: I = Σmᵢrᵢ² (Eq. 3.19). Unit: kg m².

book_ref.quote: The quantity mr² is known as the moment of inertia and is represented by I.

blocks.prompt:
45 Two cylinders have equal mass. Which has the greater rotational inertia, and why?
(Do cylinders ka mass barabar hai. Kis ka rotational inertia zyada hai aur kyun?)
blocks.explanation: Bare diameter wale ka. Moment of inertia sirf mass par nahi balkay r² par bhi munhasir hai; chaure cylinder mein mass axis se door hai, is liye Σmᵢrᵢ² zyada hai.

book_ref.quote: Two cylinders of equal mass. The one with the larger diameter

blocks.prompt:
46 Compare Newton's second law for linear motion with its rotational analogue.
(Linear motion ke Newton ke doosre qanoon ka us ke rotational mutabadil se muqabla karein.)
blocks.explanation: τ = Iα mein F ki jagah τ, a ki jagah α aur m ki jagah I = mr².

book_ref.quote: Here F is replaced by τ, a by α and m by mr².

blocks.prompt:
47 Three small masses 0.50 kg, 0.50 kg and 1.0 kg are fixed on a light rod at 0.10 m, 0.20 m and 0.30 m from the axis. Find the moment of inertia.
(Halki rod par axis se 0.10 m, 0.20 m aur 0.30 m par 0.50 kg, 0.50 kg aur 1.0 kg ke masses lage hain. Moment of inertia nikalein.)

book_ref.quote: Most rigid bodies have different mass concentration at different distances from the axis of rotation

blocks.prompt:
48 A wheel of moment of inertia 2.5 kg m² is brought from rest to 20 rad s⁻¹ uniformly in 4.0 s. Find the torque applied.
(2.5 kg m² moment of inertia wala pahiya saakin halat se 4.0 s mein yaksaan tor par 20 rad s⁻¹ tak laya jata hai. Lagaya gaya torque nikalein.)

book_ref.quote: where I is the moment of inertia of the body and is expressed as

blocks.prompt:
49 Define angular momentum. Give its magnitude and SI unit.
(Angular momentum ki definition likhein. Is ki magnitude aur SI unit batayein.)
blocks.explanation: Origin O ke gird p momentum wale particle ka angular momentum L = r × p hai, jahan r O se position vector hai. Magnitude: L = rp sin θ = mrv sin θ. SI unit: kg m² s⁻¹ ya J s.

book_ref.quote: relative to the origin O is defined as:

blocks.prompt:
50 How is the direction of angular momentum found?
(Angular momentum ki simt kaise maloom ki jati hai?)
blocks.explanation: L = r × p, r aur p ke plane par amoodi hai; us ka rukh vector product ke right hand rule se. Ghoomte jism ke liye L axis ke saath ω ki simt mein hai.

book_ref.quote: The direction of L is perpendicular to the plane formed by r and p

blocks.prompt:
51 Show that the angular momentum of a particle moving in a circle is L = mr²ω.
(Sabit karein ke circle mein chalte particle ka angular momentum L = mr²ω hai.)
blocks.explanation: Circle mein r aur tangential velocity 90° par hain: L = mrv sin 90° = mrv. v = rω rakhne se L = mr²ω.

book_ref.quote: then angle between r and tangential velocity is 90

blocks.prompt:
52 Differentiate between linear momentum and angular momentum.
(Linear momentum aur angular momentum mein farq bayan karein.)
blocks.explanation: Linear momentum seedhi harkat ki quantity hai; angular momentum gardishi harkat ki.

book_ref.quote: linear momentum plays an important role in translational motion of bodies

rows: L = r × p; rigid body ke liye L = Iω
Simt r aur p par amoodi (axis ke saath).
Unit: kg m² s⁻¹ ya J s.

blocks.prompt:
53 When is the angular momentum of a moving particle about a point zero?
(Harkat karte particle ka kisi point ke gird angular momentum kab sifr hota hai?)
blocks.explanation: L = rp sin θ. Agar particle point se guzarti line par chale (θ = 0° ya 180°) to sin θ = 0 aur L = 0, chahe particle chal raha ho; us ki angular position nahi badalti.

book_ref.quote: where θ is the angle between r and p

blocks.prompt:
54 A disc of moment of inertia 0.020 kg m² rotates at 300 rpm. Find its angular momentum.
(0.020 kg m² moment of inertia wali disc 300 rpm par ghoomti hai. Us ka angular momentum nikalein.)

book_ref.quote: Summing this over all particles gives the total angular momentum of the rigid body.

blocks.prompt:
55 A 1000 kg satellite moves in a circular orbit of radius 7.0 × 10⁶ m at 7.5 × 10³ m s⁻¹. Find its orbital angular momentum.
(1000 kg ka satellite 7.0 × 10⁶ m radius ke gol orbit mein 7.5 × 10³ m s⁻¹ se chalta hai. Us ka orbital angular momentum nikalein.)

book_ref.quote: Orbital angular momentum of the Earth

blocks.text: 3.6 Law of conservation of angular momentum

blocks.prompt:
56 State the law of conservation of angular momentum.
(Angular momentum ke tahaffuz ka qanoon bayan karein.)
blocks.explanation: Agar system par koi bairooni torque na lage to us ka kul angular momentum constant rehta hai: L₁ + L₂ + ... = constant. Moment of inertia badalne wale jism ke liye: I₁ω₁ = I₂ω₂.

book_ref.quote: if no external torque acts on a system, the total angular momentum of the system remains constant

blocks.prompt:
57 Why does the Earth's axis of rotation stay fixed in one direction in space?
(Zameen ka axis of rotation khala mein aik simt mein kyun qaim rehta hai?)
blocks.explanation: Angular momentum axis ke saath vector hai, aur bairooni torque ke baghair axis rukh nahi badalta. Zameen par bari force Sooraj ki kashish hai jo koi qabil-e-zikr torque nahi deti, is liye axis qaim rehta hai.

book_ref.quote: The Earth's axis of rotation, therefore, remains fixed in one direction with reference to the universe around us.

blocks.prompt:
58 Why does a bike at rest fall over while a moving bike stays upright?
(Khari bike gir jati hai jab ke chalti bike seedhi kyun rehti hai?)
blocks.explanation: Chalti bike ke pahiye ghoomte hain aur un ka angular momentum hota hai. Yeh tabdeeli ki mukhalifat karta hai aur bike ko seedha rakhta hai. Khari bike ke pahiyon ka angular momentum nahi hota.

book_ref.quote: the angular momentum of the spinning wheel resists any tendency to change and helps to keep the bike upright and stable

blocks.prompt:

(Ghoomti gend ka dhaaga ungli par lipatne se gend tez kyun ho jati hai?)
blocks.explanation: Koi bairooni torque nahi, is liye angular momentum (L = mr²ω) constant rehta hai. Dhaaga lipatne se r aur moment of inertia kam hote hain, is liye angular speed aur gend ki speed barhti hai.

book_ref.quote: The ball's speed increases as the string wraps around the finger.

blocks.explanation: Baazu samet kar aur taang andar la kar moment of inertia kam karta hai, to angular velocity barhti hai (Iω constant). Haath aur taang phailane se moment of inertia barhta hai aur angular velocity kam hoti hai.

book_ref.quote: can increase his angular velocity by folding arms and bringing the stretched leg close to the other leg

I₁ω₁ = I₂ω₂

blocks.prompt:
65 What is a flywheel? Give its uses.
(Flywheel kya hai? Is ke istemal batayein.)
blocks.explanation: Flywheel dhure (axle) wala bhaari pahiya hai. Yeh rotational energy jama karta hai, utaar charhao hamwaar karta hai aur cycle, gaariyon, machinery, gyroscope, jahazon aur spacecraft mein istehkaam deta hai. Ghoomte waqt us ka angular momentum rukh badalne nahi deta.

book_ref.quote: Flywheel is a mechanical device which consists of a heavy wheel with an axle

blocks.prompt:

(Gyroscope kya hai? Is ke axis ka rukh badalna mushkil kyun hai?)
blocks.explanation: Gyroscope sahara dene wale chhallon mein laga flywheel hai jo rukh qaim rakhta hai. Bare moment of inertia ke saath tez ghoomne par us ka angular momentum bara hota hai; is ka rukh badalne ke liye bara torque chahiye, is liye axis apna rukh qaim rakhta hai.

book_ref.quote: It consists of a mounted flywheel pivoted in supporting rings
